ChannelRest.description: The rest criteria a runtime declares for one channel it sources.

criteria.description: When its readings count as at rest.

GripperActuator.description: One actuator of a gripper and its control values when closed and when open.

closed.description: Control value for an opening of 0.

open.description: Control value for an opening of 1.

GripperCompletion.description: How the runtime decides that a gripper command's motion has ended, from the

goal_tolerance.description: How close to the target counts as reached.

stall_delta.description: How much the opening may vary while it counts as still.

stall_dwell_ns.description: How long it must stay still to count as stopped.

GripperOpening.description: The gripper joint whose position measures the opening, calibrated: the opening is

closed.description: Its position when the fingers close on nothing.

open.description: Its position when the fingers are open.

GripperProfile.description: How a gripper's opening maps to its actuators, and how it is measured.

actuators.description: Its actuators; each is driven between its closed and open values.

opening.description: The joint that measures the opening; the actuators' lengths if none.

completion.description: How a gripper command's motion is decided to have ended. Without one, a gripper command is refused (no_gripper_completion); an action chunk's gripper steps are unaffected.

MujocoProfile.description: MuJoCo-specific settings a robot package declares for ``MujocoRuntime``.

model.description: The package model MuJoCo compiles. Defaults to the canonical model if it is MJCF, else the package's only MJCF model.

keyframe.description: The keyframe the runtime opens in by default.

grippers.description: How each commandable gripper maps to its actuators.

rest.description: Rest criteria for the description's joint-position or pose channels, as this simulation produces them; a channel not listed has none.

RestCriteria.description: When a channel's readings count as at rest: declared by the runtime that sources the

max_gap_ns.description: The largest spacing between samples still treated as continuous.

dwell_ns.description: How long the readings must stay within bounds.

variation.description: The most each element's range may be over the dwell, one bound per element of the channel; joint-position channels only.

translation_m.description: The most each position coordinate's range may be over the dwell; pose only.

rotation_rad.description: The largest angle any orientation may be from the dwell's first; pose only.

source.description: Where the values come from: a datasheet, a driver, or a measurement.
